title: Back to the compass
learning_goal: Separate what was measured from what is bet, and leave with the one-sentence lesson.
takeaway: No one can say when the needle will turn, but in models we can learn how often, by enforcing each law where it is true.
notes: Closing chapter, L5 → L0, no question card: a deliberate deviation from BRIEF section 3.1 ('a question card ends every chapter'), to be confirmed by the lead: ch10q 'Before we compute', which plays just before (assemble_cut EXTRA_UNITS), gathers and ranks every question, and a card after the end card, or between the lesson and the end card, would break the closing; 11.1's first line, 'Questions first, then computing.', lands right after that list (and still reads after ch10.Q while ch10q is not written). Chapter card T4 in the 3.4-s lead-in of 11.1 (tiers 0-1 lit, 2-4 dashed, rail at L5); the rail descends L5 → L0 in 11.2, the film's one declared descent. Music: off in 11.1 (L5), full from 11.2 (L0): the bed returns with the compass. STATUS AND RELEASE MODEL (critique H2, BRIEF D4/D5). 11.1 is PENDING, not ready: its right column is a row of empty seats, and its narration has a 'result' variant. 11.2 and 11.3 are READY and their narration is written to stay true when results arrive ('are written as bets', 'the rest of the staircase is still to be computed'), so the outline's results-in variant of the closing paragraph moves from 11.2 to 11.1, where the verdicts are on screen. 11.1 reads ONE aggregate file instead of the six cloud files, because (i) a scene's re-render hash covers only its deps, and (ii) assemble_cut switches to the result variant only when EVERY dep exists: with the six files as deps, the variant would wait for the VKS and DRESDYN consortium data, years away. DATA, TWO NEW FILES requested from the foundation engineer (read-only extraction, no run). (1) data/ch11_measured.json (READY, tools/data_existing.py, from experiences/resultats/e1_gissinger.json, e2_mhd2d.json, e3_abc.json and digest.md): meta.stamp 'DATA · E1–E3 · headline results' (≤ 44 characters); e1 {seeds 2, mirror {asym_C_min 0.0037, asym_C_max 0.0048, floor 0.0040}, distance {A 0.0118, C 0.00257, ratio 4.6}, per_snapshot {E 0.0231, C 0.00257, ratio 9}, rice {model 'C', seed 0, n_per_gamma 20000, far {gamma_min 0.89, percent 14}, near {gamma_min 0.865, gamma_max 0.885, percent 42}, pointwise_max_percent 65}} (rice: the same computation as data/ch09_rice.json check.C, asserting 14 and 42 as in R:883; copy it if that file exists); e2 {seeds 1, grid '32²', dynamo false, divergence {free 0.408, potentials 1.7e-17 (V4 mean of u and B, R:1027)}, crowd {V4 2.58, control 2.52, V5 0.699}, per_snapshot {sigma_ratio 8.64e-4}}; e3 {grid '32³', thresholds [8.87, 17.6, 26.8] (digest.json e3_thresholds), published [8.9, 17.5, 27], published_third_approx true, unresolved_at 17.5, divergence_max 1.52e-16}; caveats ['toy problems', 'interpolation only', 'CPU, 4 cores, no GPU', 'prospective report']. Used by 11.1 (left column) and 11.2 (the rate chip). (2) data/ch11_ledger.json (the BET column; written by tools/data_existing.py or tools/data_cloud.py, refreshed after EVERY data_cloud conversion, ideally by data_cloud.py itself): rows, one per bet of params.bets, matched by id [tier1_check → data/palier1_sweep.json, abc64 → palier2_abc3d.json, tg → palier2_tg3d.json, fm3d → fm3d_eval.json, vks → tier3_vks.json, dresdyn → tier4_dresdyn.json], each {id, scene, file, state: 'awaiting' | the file's own verdict (met | not_met | inconclusive, copied, never recomputed; a file with pending: true counts as awaiting), verdict_text, stamp (the file's meta.stamp), sha8 (first 8 hex of its meta.sha256)}; meta.sources = [{path, sha256}] of every present bet file, so the ledger changes whenever one of them changes (that re-renders 11.1); fields {n_bets 6, n_in, n_met, n_not_met, n_inconclusive, n_awaiting (integers: the build speaks them as words), any_met, any_not_met, any_inconclusive, top_awaiting (booleans; top_awaiting = VKS and DRESDYN both awaiting)}; and pending: true at the root as long as NONE of the three tier-2 files (palier2_abc3d, palier2_tg3d, fm3d_eval) is present: the result narration starts when the first 3D bet is in (the outline's rule), not for the 2D data check alone. Until then 11.1 renders its pending narration, and its lamps still update on screen. Writing the ledger now, with every row 'awaiting' and pending: true, is safe (load_data treats it as missing). BETS: wording, confidence (10.3 high, 10.4 medium, 10.5 medium, 10.7 low, 10.9 low) and tags copied from script/ch10.json; if ch10 changes, update entry.params.bets of 11.1. CHANGES AGAINST THE OUTLINE, to review: (1) 11.1 pending with a result variant (above); 11.2 ready and timeless, 'You have seen the bets' and 'still ahead' dropped. (2) 11.2 opens on the two questions of 00.4 and scopes 'when': Earth through NOAA NCEI (CONTEXT, reference chip, the ch00 source) and the three-mode model through P4:1627, never 'the dynamos we can compute' (critique B2; ch00 says 'a simple computer model'). (3) 'Read with the equations' added to the shoebox line: Rice needs the right-hand side (pitfall P15). (4) Montage motifs: barcode, whirlpools, toll counter, shoebox, violet cloud, mirror, rate chart, stiff sheet, staircase; the threads of ch02 are dropped (no closing sentence about stretching) and the amber histogram moves to the third lesson line. (5) 11.3 gets one spoken sentence pair and a 3-s silent tail for reading; the disclaimer text is composed from H:45, R:51, R:59 and T:57 (D14 says 'as drafted in the outline', which gives only the 03.7 lower-third). SYMBOL SHEET: crossing rate on screen, 'rate of zero crossings' in narration (B16); s for growth rate; Γ, η, Rm, Pm, Po green; 'distribution distance' amber, never 'energy distance'; no μ or ν; model C, seed 0 on every Rice number. LEXICON: no new word (no acronym is spoken). Words budgeted with the assembler formula (146 raw words per minute, 0.9 s per paragraph break, holds, lead-in and tail); effective pace 125-131 words per minute on 11.1 and 11.2; 11.3 is deliberately slower (reading tail). Adversarial review 2026-11-08: changelog and evidence in script/_review/ch11.md.

Each card ends with its caveat chip (plain, mono 28, bottom-right of the card: params.measured_rows[i].chip). On 'limits-0.15': under the left column (y 800-860) one plain chip 'toy problems · interpolation only · CPU, 4 cores, no GPU · prospective report' (text from measured.caveats) and the pen (M9) underlines 'interpolation only'. P2. On 'bets-0.15': six bet rows deal in on the right (x 1000-1800, y 200-800, params.deal_s apart), top to bottom from tier 1 to tier 4, from params.bets: a small grey step glyph with the tier number (the M7 staircase in miniature; the three tier-2 rows share one taller step), the name (32, semibold), the bet (28, --fg-2, markup), confidence pips at the right (three pips, filled per params.confidence_pips), and the grey data tag 'DATA · <tag> · AWAITING' (mono 28) with a lamp drawn in the Kit.seat lamp style (dashed empty circle, r 22). Row height about 96 px; if a row overflows 800 px, the tag moves to a third line and the rows tighten, never below 28 px. On 'lights-0.15': the lamps pulse once top to bottom (0.15 s apart). For every row whose ledger row (ctx.data.ledger.rows, matched by id) has state met, not_met or inconclusive, the lamp takes the seat's result marks (filled --fg disc with a check; a cross; a question mark), the tag becomes the row's stamp and the first 8 hex digits of its SHA-256 (row.stamp, row.sha8) and the word AWAITING becomes MET, NOT MET or INCONCLUSIVE (row.state, Kit.upper); rows still awaiting stay dashed. Then a plain chip under the right column (y 820-860): '→ what to ask before computing: chapter “Before we compute”'. Result variant only: the cues 'met', 'failed', 'open' and 'top' exist only when their sentence is kept, so test ctx.script.cues before ctx.at; on each, the rows in that state (met, not_met, inconclusive; on 'top' the VKS and DRESDYN rows) brighten for 1.2 s while the others dim to 50 %. When the status is provisional, the runtime adds the PROVISIONAL DATA stamp with the ledger's stamp: keep the top-centre strip clear for it. Badge MEASURED top-right from 'columns' (note from the script). No corner needle (D is not on screen), no lower-third, no formula layer: the caveat chips carry the provenance. Never more than 3 s of stillness: the lamps breathe faintly (opacity 85-100 %) after 'lights'.

sentences.text: Back to the compass, and to the two questions.
When will this needle turn?
For the Earth, no one can say.
In a simple computer model, chaos makes the forecast fade before the average wait ends.
But {metric}how often{/} the field flips, counted as crossings of zero, can still be answered.
The answer hides in a shoebox of snapshots, read with the equations.
And a {model}machine{/} can learn to dream such snapshots, between the simulated settings.
On small test problems, it partly works.
The mirror holds by construction, at every setting.
On three dials, the {metric}rate of zero crossings{/} is roughly right far from the threshold, and poor near it.
A smooth machine rounds off a steep change.
The bigger tests, in three dimensions and in the shapes of real machines, are written as bets.
One lesson remains.
Enforce each law where it is true.
Exactly, where it is exact.
{metric}On average{/}, where it only holds on average.

scenes.visual: Render class webgl for the compass shots only (P1, 'when', P4), flat or dense 2D for the montage in between: the Three.js compass of 00.1 (same model, same framing, matte grey body, vermillion north tip, no hand: critique G3) stops rendering and is hidden from 'chaos-0.4' to 'lesson-0.6' (give it an out and an in, so the WebGL cost covers about 20 s, not 70). Data: measured = data/ch11_measured.json (chips), e1 = data/e1_finegrid.json (config for the whirlpools, the two series and the threshold for the rate chart), s093 = data/e1_samples_0.93.json (variants.ref.x for the shoebox photos, variants.C_equivariant.x for the cloud and the mirror, variants.C_equivariant.dEdt for the histogram; meta.stamp). No number typed in the scene. Montage grammar (critique G6): one motif per sentence, 3 to 4 s or the sentence's length, inside params.montage_box; the previous motif leaves in 0.2 s as the next one cuts in (no blur crossfade); at most three key colours per motif; music at full level (L0) from the first frame, rising out of the silence of 11.1 (the bed's 3-s crossfade). P1. Lead-in (0.8 s): black, then the compass fades up; the needle swings in from east and settles on north (Kit.needle, corner false, Scene.spring, at most 3 % overshoot), then idles with a faint wobble. On 'compass-0.15': the two cards of 00.4 slide in small under the compass (each about 520 × 130, y 720-850): left 'When will it flip next?' with the grey clock icon, right 'How often does it flip?' with amber tally marks; the rail (M8, Kit.rail(params.rail)) shows in the left gutter and descends L5 → L0 over 4 s, the film's one declared descent (pedagogy rule 1). P2. On 'when-0.15': the left card lights; a translucent ghost needle (30 %) starts to swing toward south and fades halfway, while the real needle stays on north (callback to the ghost needles of 00.1). On 'earth-0.15': the compass slides to the top-left and shrinks (it stays there, small, until 'chaos-0.4'); the polarity strip of 00.3 draws in across the box (Kit.barcode built from params.normal_Ma exactly as in 00.3, two vermillion shades, NO axis and no numbers) with the chalk label 'seafloor record · no schedule'; the plain chip 'for Earth: no one can say if or when · NOAA NCEI' (the ch00 chip of 00.4, verbatim) sits under the strip, and the reference lower-third 'Reference' / 'NOAA NCEI · polarity ages: Cande & Kent 1995' shows for 4 s (BRIEF D7). On 'chaos-0.15': the whirlpools of 04.2: the three-mode model integrated in the scene as in 04.2 (Scene.stepper, RK4, params.chaos.dt, coefficients from ctx.data.e1.config, Γ = params.chaos.gamma, pre-integrated onto the attractor in setup); two runs start params.chaos.delta apart, one --fg and one --silver, with short trails; they trace the same loops, then visibly part within about two loops; chalk label 'two starts, a hair apart'; plain chip 'three-mode model (Gissinger 2012)'. No axes and no D label, so no corner needle. The 'When' card comes back small at the top-left and dims to 40 % with a dashed border. On 'often-0.15': the toll counter of 05.1 in miniature (road, chalk line, grey cars crossing it, the counter clicking up: three ticks from the script sfx), chalk label 'crossings of zero'; the 'How often' card returns small at the top-right, lights amber, and the pen (M9) underlines 'How often'. On 'shoebox-0.15': the shoebox of 04.6, reused as is (scenes/_shared if it was moved there): params.shoebox.photos three-dial photos, their readings from s093.variants.ref.x (seeded picks), drop into the open grey box in shuffled order; chalk label 'no clock'. On 'cloud-0.15': the photos dissolve into points; a seeded round violet Gaussian flows along params.cloud.strings straight strings (Kit.cloud) onto the generated (Q, D) cloud at Γ = 0.93 (s093.variants.C_equivariant.x, first params.cloud.n points, Q across and D up, no axes); under it a green ruler with five filled dots (simulated settings) and the pointer landing on an open dot between two of them (schematic, no numbers); violet chip 'generated · model C' and the label 'between the simulated settings'; a soft granular hiss (script sfx). P3. On 'partly-0.15': the cloud shrinks to the left; three small grey bench glyphs in a row (three dials, a flat sheet, a wireframe box; 160 px) with the labels 'E1', 'E2', 'E3' and the plain chip 'toy problems · CPU'. On 'mirror-0.15': the violet cloud returns at centre; Kit.mirror({mode: 'point'}) sends it through the origin (S: (Q, D) → (−Q, −D), a point reflection, never a line mirror): the reflected copy lands on the cloud itself; a small polarity balance (the 07.1 glyph, two pans in the two vermillion shades) levels; chip 'built in · Proposition 4'. On 'rate-0.15': the 09.1 chart in miniature (Kit.plot in the montage box, y1 ≤ 640): x axis 'Γ' in green with the threshold band (e1.threshold) and no tick numbers, counted crossings solid --b ('simulation (counted crossings)', label 'counted'), Rice on generated snapshots dashed amber with the violet GENERATED chip ('Rice, generated (model C)', label 'generated'), both read from params.rate_chart.series; the area between the curves shaded amber at 20 %; at the end of the words 'far from the threshold' (word timing from ctx.script.sentences; fallback 'rate+2.6') a bracket over the right part, and at the sentence's end a bracket at the threshold; then the chip 'cumulative error: 14 % far from the threshold · 42 % near it · model C, seed 0' (numbers from measured.e1.rice). On 'steep-0.15': the 09.3 metaphor glyph replaces the chart: a violet stiff sheet that rounds the corner of a steep amber ramp, labels 'too early' and 'too low', grey dashed SCHEMATIC chip. On 'bets-0.15': the staircase (M7, Kit.staircase(params.staircase)) with the 03.7 tier labels: tiers 0-1 lit, tier 2 with the faint E3 preview mark, tiers 2-4 dashed, each upper step tagged with a grey dashed 'BET · rule written first' (no AWAITING tag: this scene stays true when results arrive; the verdicts live in 11.1). P4. On 'lesson-0.6': every motif clears in 0.5 s; the clean compass returns at left-centre (x 300-900), WebGL, needle on north, idle breathing. On 'where-0.15': line 1 'Enforce each law where it is true.' (Inter Display 60, --fg) types in at the right (x 980-1800, y about 300). On 'exact-0.15': line 2 'Exactly, where it is exact.' (44) with a small single-card glyph in a solid --chalk outline (the 'exact' tag of 00.4 and the per-snapshot shelf of 07.1, never blue). On 'average-0.15': line 3 'On average, where it only holds on average.' (44, 'On average' in amber) with the amber stack-of-cards glyph and a small amber histogram (M5, Kit.histogram, values s093.variants.C_equivariant.dEdt, params.histogram.bins, no axis numbers) whose bars breathe while its width stays put: the histogram that keeps its width. Tail (3.0 s): hold; the needle gives one faint tremor of about 2 degrees and settles on north again (no flip: no one can say when).
